title: Have You Tried Unplugging It?
description: Ronnie runs the Snazzie FM tech help desk, answering real listener gadget woes with total confidence and one fix for everything. Barry watches in quiet horror.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Snazzie FM tech help desk is open, folks. Whatever the gadget, I have the answer. Barry, read me the first one.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Marlene writes, quote, my laptop keeps flickering and the only photos of my late husband are in a folder I can't back up.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Aw, Marlene. The flickering means it's breathing. <p:0.3> Have you tried unplugging it? Mid-update, the photos come back stronger.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Devon works from home, quote, my wifi drops every afternoon on video calls and my boss thinks I'm slacking.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy, Devon. Too much internet stacking up. Unplug the router mid-call, it clears the line.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: But then the call also ends, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Clean line, Barry. <p:0.3> Quick follow-up from last week's Devon.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He unplugged the router, then unplugged the next thing over, which was the fridge. <p:0.3> He's asking if you can fix a freezer full of warm fish.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Have you tried unplugging it, Devon.
